craft_notes: Sthāyin: bind-joy. Close: making. Rejected: 'all directions' spelled — kept 'of the ten'; 'should' — 'let' kept.

lines: of the ten, let bonds be made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nyāsaṃ krtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃsatimantritām | ekaikena diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānām api kārayet

reads_against.argmap: Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered — every direction bound, all ten.
c1_essence: Placing done, topknot bound; all ten quarters bound.
